英語文 · 國三上學期 · 章節筆記

授予動詞、使役動詞與現在完成式進階

Dative verbs take two objects: direct (thing) and indirect (person). When the person follows, prepositions are required: "to" for transfer (give, send, show), "for" for benefit/effort (buy, make, cook). Causative verbs (make, have, let) take an object and a bare infinitive (base verb). Present perfect with "since" indicates an action starting at a specific point in time.

章節重點

使役動詞
make/have/let + 受詞 + 原形動詞；get + 受詞 + to VMom made me clean my room. / Dad let him drive the car.
授予動詞介系詞
give/send/show + 物 + to + 人；buy/make/cook + 物 + for + 人He gave a gift to me. = He gave me a gift. / Mom bought a cake for us.
現在完成式持續
have/has + p.p. 搭配 since（接時間點）或 for（接時間長度）I have lived here for ten years. / She has studied English since 2018.

示範與推理

改寫「Dad bought me a bike.」並完成「He let me ___ (ride) it. I have had it ___ 2023.」，再說明為何最後不用 have bought。

  1. 雙受詞改為 Dad bought a bike for me.，buy 在此搭配 for，不能機械套所有動詞都用 to。
  2. 使役句為 He let me ride it.，let 後接 me 和原形 ride，不用 to ride。
  3. 最後填 since 2023，表示持有狀態從 2023 延續至今：I have had it since 2023.。

易錯提醒　Do not use "to V" after causative verbs (say "Mom let me go", not "Mom let me to go"). "Since" takes a specific starting point; "for" takes a duration of time.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. My father made my brother ___ his bedroom before going out to play.
    • A．cleaned
    • B．cleaning
    • C．clean
    • D．to clean
  2. Create two pairs of sentences showing dative verb transformations with "to" and "for", and one sentence using "let" or "make".
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　C（clean）。The causative verb "make" requires an object followed by the base form of the verb ("clean").

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
